title: IPS buys Belyea’s high-voltage business
detail: Refurbished 69–230 kV transformers, breakers and switchgear, plus portable-substation rental, based in Easton PA. Terms undisclosed.
implication: Third aftermarket or rental deal in three months. Investors pay for anything that can deliver in under two years.

title: DOE comments on the grid-equipment order close
detail: Docket DOE-HQ-2026-1123 under EO 14421. Implementing rules are due around Dec 24.
implication: The rules decide whether data-center substations count, which sets who can sell large units.

title: Marsons and Cleanhill form a US–Canada venture
detail: Indian maker of 11–345 kV units and GSUs up to 200 MVA teams with a New York private-equity firm. Imports first, local manufacturing later. Marsons stock rose up to 16%.
implication: First visible Indian move after the order on Chinese equipment.

title: Cleveland-Cliffs shows its GOES expansion
detail: $200M plus a $75M DOE award adds up to 25% more grain-oriented electrical steel at Butler Works. Energy Secretary Wright visited.
implication: Real but small relief on the scarcest input. No completion date given.

title: Schneider Electric agrees to buy PTC for $22.6B
implication: Shows how much cash electrical-equipment majors can deploy.

title: Copper holds near its record
detail: About $6.66/lb on COMEX, close to the $6.89 high of Sep 9.

title: Voltamp starts its new plant in India
detail: Commercial production began at the Vadodara power-transformer plant.
implication: More Indian capacity that could ship to North America.

title: WEG adds $165M of generator capacity in North America
detail: Generators, not transformers; Mexico first phase in Q2 2027.

title: Hitachi Energy plans a $528M Mississippi plant
detail: 10–160 MVA units up to 230 kV, production in 2029, more than 700 jobs.

title: Hyosung wins $287M of US orders
detail: 765 kV and 345 kV units for two US tech companies’ data centers.

title: DOE asks for comments on the grid-equipment order
detail: Request for information published in the Federal Register.

title: MacLean Power Systems to buy Delta Star
detail: Blackstone- and Centerbridge-backed platform adds power transformers and mobile substations. Closing Q4 2026.

title: Niagara Power Transformer expands
detail: $71M to go from 90 to 140 units a year (owned by Quanta).

title: Executive order on foreign grid equipment
detail: National emergency covering transformers, inverters, batteries and breakers from 24 countries, mainly China.
